newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae group proposes joint meeting.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae group proposes joint meeting.

text.p: The Committee to Restore Value (CRV), an opposition shareholders group at Student Loan Marketing Association (Sallie Mae), said Thursday it is proposing that Sallie Mae and the Committee jointly call a shareholders meeting.

The CRV said at the proposed meeting shareholders would have one vote on whether Sallie Mae should privatize. The CRV said it is proposing that shareholders have a separate vote on two competing slates of directors.

Earlier Thursday, Sallie Mae adjourned a special meeting of shareholders until June 5 after management's privatization plan failed to win the support of a majority of outstanding shares. A plan of the CRV last week also failed to receive a majority. The CRV said it would continue counting votes until May 29.
